title: The Order of Things
summary: A list of nine artists reorders itself according to the reader's locale, exposing 'alphabetical order' as a cultural fiction.
mechanism: The browser's built-in Intl.Collator locale tables (ICU) compute precedence live per selected locale, with a FLIP reorder animation; no network, storage, or fonts.
references: Alighiero Boetti, Classifying the thousand longest rivers in the world (1977)
Jorge Luis Borges, The Analytical Language of John Wilkins (1942)
Michel Foucault, Les mots et les choses (1966)
